svg.title: Preserving one logical state under physical slicing
svg.desc: Within one kc panel and a fixed row m, the logical state over N is divided into disjoint slices P0 and P1. Dashed projections give s_i^t = s^t[P_i] at every step. The prepared value wp feeds contribution nodes delta, each added to its own state. Each slice is initialised from and stored to the same Y coordinates; no state passes between the slices.
